title: handy machine, reliable
body:
Display is ok, but not super brilliant like a quality OLED
Touch screen is handy, Battery life is around 4 hours only
AMD Shared graphics card is not the best, may need to reallocate RAM as Vram using AMD Adrenalin
The Power adaptor is awkward tends to fall out of the power socket
product_name: HP OmniBook X 14" Touchscreen 2-in-1 Laptop - Deep Espresso Aluminum (AMD Ryzen Ai7 450 (Zen 5c)/32GB RAM/1TB SSD/Windows 11 Home)
